parts.text: Say in an upbeat, confident narrator voice: Blurry or low-res photo? Image Enhancer fixes it right in Chrome, and nothing ever leaves your device. Hit Enhance to kill noise and sharpen detail. Need more size? Upscale up to four times. Out of focus? Unblur brings the edges back. Every mode runs locally and free. No sign-up, no watermark. Get it on the Chrome Web Store.
